thread:
sam: Quick thread — customers (AcmeHealth + BetaCorp) pressed for visibility before GA: per-tenant cost, compact error analytics, and a lightweight tracing hook. Need a minimum deliverable.
neha: I think we should define a "GA minimum" that is useful but not an arms race. Suggest: Tenant Overview dashboard + daily cost CSV + LLM-span tags (no cross-service stitching).
derek: Agreed. For tracing, just emit a span at the gateway with tags: tenant_id, model, route, token_count. Sampling default 10% and configurable. That keeps perf impact tiny.
ira: Dashboard mocks: one template called "Tenant Overview": requests/min, p50/p95, error %, cost trend sparkline, top slow routes. Filters: tenant, last 24h, model. No drilldown charts for GA.
sam: Acceptance criteria draft: ```
- Dashboard: Tenant Overview template available in library; widgets load <1.5s for 30s lookback.
- Tracing hooks: spans emitted for LLM requests with required tags; sampling configurable.
- Cost: daily per-tenant token counts + cost estimate exported as CSV; accuracy within 5% of billing totals.
- Error analytics: show top-5 error messages by tenant and route with link to raw logs.
- Rollout: feature-flagged per-tenant; BetaCorp and AcmeHealth enabled initially.
```
neha: Risks: billing feed has ~2h lag; call that out in UI copy and CSV header. Also billing accuracy depends on token normalization; add a note.
derek: Estimates: platform: 2 sprints (2 engs) for spans and billing glue; frontend: 1 sprint (1 eng + designer) for dashboard + CSV; ops: 2 days for runbook.
ira: Prioritization question: if we can only do one item this sprint, which?
sam: Dashboards give immediate signal to customers and internal teams.
neha: Sales says cost data materially affects renewals; they may push cost CSV first.
derek: From oncall POV, spans reduce time-to-detect; if SRE backlog is high, tracing hooks could be priority.
sam: My recommendation: sprint A = dashboards + cost CSV; sprint B = tracing hooks + runbook. Minimizes cross-team churn and gives customers cost numbers quickly.
ira: Decision: follow sam. Action items: @derek infra ETA + PR plan, @ira mocks by Tue, @neha customer comms + FAQ blurb, @sam write GA gating doc.
release-bot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/observe-ga-minimum-surface :bookmark_tabs:
sam: GA gating notes for doc: dashboard availability >= 99.5%, cost daily accuracy <= 5%, no >2x median latency regression on 95% of routes when sampling enabled, widgets load <1.5s. Add monitoring hooks and rollback criteria.
neha: I'll collect two customer quotes for release notes and confirm BetaCorp acceptance.
derek: I'll add an infra risk entry for quota or billing API changes.
ira: Thanks all — schedule a 30m follow-up tomorrow to lock PR owners. :thumbsup:
